question: How does equal vision arise without erasing practical distinction?
premises: equal seers see sameness in all beings
consciousness-nature is one in all bodies
inference: equal vision is recognition of shared consciousness, not denial of worldly difference
uncertainties: fused sandhi tokens are not split
verse references are treated as paratext
plain_english: The wise see equally in brahmin, cow, elephant, dog, and outcaste, yet act appropriately; consciousness-nature is one in all bodies.
